cases.name: Salina Marie Araiza
cases.about: She was going to attend college to be a nurse. Her friend said Araiza was the type of person who knew how to brighten your day, even if you were having a bad one. "Every time we'd be down, we'd be sad, she's always have something fun and funny to say. ... If you had a bad day, she'd always be, you know, making us laugh.
